items.title: RTX (RTX) Wins DARPA Contract For All Optical Signal Processing
items.summary: RTX (NYSE:RTX) unit Raytheon secured a phase one contract from DARPA for all-optical signal processing under the PICASSO program. The PICASSO effort focuses on advanced photonic circuit technology that targets faster threat detection and response in contested environments. The contract underscores DARPA's interest in all-optical processing systems for national security applications using Raytheon's research capabilities.
